# Michał Kruczek

> Personal homepage of Michał Kruczek, a full-stack developer and AI specialist working with .NET, AI/ML and cloud infrastructure. The site is a single page; the sections below summarize it.

Michał builds modern, scalable web applications and offers consulting and training. Works at LUXMED (per the site's structured data).

## Services

- .NET Full-Stack Development: Enterprise applications using .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, and modern frontend frameworks (Angular/React/Vue.js, MSSQL)
- AI & Machine Learning: AI software development, infrastructure setup, and AI-based system implementations (OpenAI integration, PyTorch & Pandas, FastAPI)
- Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps: Scalable cloud solutions with Azure, Kubernetes, and microservices architecture
- DevOps & Deployment: Automated CI/CD pipelines and production deployment strategies (Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps & Git)
- Consulting: Technical guidance, architecture planning, and team leadership
- AI Training & Workshops: Training on GitHub Copilot, LLM integration, and AI tools for enterprise teams
